card.name: Space before clock times
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) right after "at", "around" or a day name, just before a clock time such as 10 a.m. or 4:30 p.m. Mostly in news and schedule text.

modes.label: Broadcast schedules
modes.description: Space after a day name, before a show airing time.

modes.label: Event times in news
modes.description: Space after "at" or "around" before the time an event happened.
modes.example: They reached the summit at<< >>11:30 a.m.

card.writes: It seems to push toward times and counts, such as "twice" and "three times", over other continuations.
card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a clock time is written, like "at" then 4:30 p.m.
